2609.09082.title: GoDeep: Annotation-Free Open-Vocabulary 3D Scene Understanding via Language-Space Lifting
2609.09082.paper_summary: Open vocabulary 3D semantic segmentation methods typically lift CLIP features into 3D. This embeds points in a joint vision-language space known to behave like a bag-of-words on compositional tasks. Furthermore, even annotation free variants often require a large 3D training corpus and a dedicated 3D encoder per domain. Instead we use a vision-language model purely as a translator. It produces structured, entity-level descriptions of each posed image. These descriptions are grounded, projected, and aggregated directly in a general-purpose, language-only embedding space, with no 3D training corpus or encoder required. On ScanNet++, our pipeline is competitive with strong annotation free baselines trained on ScanNet. On a 5-building cultural heritage benchmark, raw scores initially favor a CLIP-based variant, but a single systematic vocabulary correction reverses this ranking. An effect confirmed by a second, independent correction on a different class, indicating that language-space embeddings track physical content more faithfully. This fidelity extends to genuinely out-of-vocabulary (OOV) objects on ScanNet++ proving that language-space embeddings separate presence from absence objects far more sharply than CLIP-based embeddings do. GoDeep also localize these OOV objects within the scene, all without any 2D-3D annotation. Because every representation remains discrete text, predictions are also explainable at the point level. Finally, exploiting both a heuristic weighting, that favors precise over merely frequent observations and GoDeep's explainability property, we propose an aggregation strategy, as a proof of concept, that favors finer elements localization.
2609.09082.paper_summary_zh: 開放詞彙的 3D 語義分割方法通常將 CLIP 特徵提升至 3D。這將點嵌入到一個已知在組合任務中表現得像詞袋的聯合視覺-語言空間中。 此外，即使是無需標註的變體通常也需要大量的 3D 訓練語料庫和每個領域專用的 3D 編碼器。相反，我們純粹將視覺-語言模型用作翻譯器。它生成每個擺姿的圖像的結構化實體級描述。這些描述在一個通用的僅語言嵌入空間中進行基於實體的基礎、投影和聚合，無需 3D 訓練語料庫或編碼器。在 ScanNet++ 上，我們的管道與在 ScanNet 上訓練的強大無標註基準相當。在一個包含 5 座建築的文化遺產基準中，原始分數最初偏向基於 CLIP 的變體，但一次系統性的詞彙修正逆轉了這一排名。這一效果通過對不同類別的第二次獨立修正得到了確認，表明語言空間嵌入對物理內容的追蹤更為忠實。這種忠實性擴展到 ScanNet++ 上真正的超出詞彙（OOV）對象，證明語言空間嵌入比基於 CLIP 的嵌入更清晰地區分存在與不存在的對象。GoDeep 也在場景中定位這些 OOV 對象，所有這些都不需要任何 2D-3D 標註。由於每個表示仍然是離散的文本，預測在點級別上也是可解釋的。最後，利用一種偏好精確而非僅僅頻繁觀察的啟發式加權和 GoDeep 的可解釋性特性，我們提出了一種聚合策略，作為概念驗證，偏向於更細緻的元素定位。
